characteristics.name: Sturdy
characteristics.description: This race is exceptionally resilient, able to withstand more physical harm than average.

characteristics.name: Intelligent
characteristics.description: Members of this race have superior cognitive abilities, allowing them to solve complex problems easily.

characteristics.name: Magic Affinity
characteristics.description: This race has a natural connection to the arcane, making them formidable spellcasters.

characteristics.name: Swift
characteristics.description: Unmatched in speed, this race can cover distances in record time or evade threats effectively.

characteristics.name: Agile
characteristics.description: With heightened reflexes and balance, this race excels in tasks requiring dexterity.

characteristics.name: Nimble Fingers
characteristics.description: This race is particularly skilled at tasks requiring finesse, such as crafting or thievery.

characteristics.name: Amphibious
characteristics.description: Capable of living both on land and water, this race can breathe underwater.

characteristics.name: Night Vision
characteristics.description: The dark is no obstacle to this race, as they can see in low light conditions as if it were daytime.

characteristics.name: Flight
characteristics.description: This race has the capability to fly, either through wings or other means.

characteristics.name: Longevity
characteristics.description: This race has a lifespan much longer than typical beings.

characteristics.name: Fire Resistance
characteristics.description: Heat and flames barely affect this race, making them immune to most fire-related threats.

characteristics.name: Cold Resistance
characteristics.description: Chilly environments are a comfort for this race, making them immune to frost and ice.

characteristics.name: Nature Bond
characteristics.description: This race shares a special bond with nature, allowing them to command flora and fauna.

characteristics.name: Charm
characteristics.description: Members of this race have a natural charisma, making them beloved and persuasive.

characteristics.name: Stealthy
characteristics.description: This race excels in moving unnoticed, making them formidable spies or hunters.

characteristics.name: Telepathy
characteristics.description: Members of this race can communicate mentally, reading thoughts or sending silent messages.

characteristics.name: Regeneration
characteristics.description: Injuries heal rapidly for this race, as they can recover from wounds in a fraction of the normal time.

characteristics.name: Fertile
characteristics.description: This race reproduces at a faster rate, leading to quicker population growth.

characteristics.name: Inferior Strength
characteristics.description: Physical strength is not a forte for this race, making them less effective in brute force tasks.

characteristics.name: Brittle Bones
characteristics.description: This race is more prone to physical injuries due to their delicate bone structure.

characteristics.name: Magic Ineptitude
characteristics.description: Magic is a challenge for this race, making them less effective or incapable of casting spells.

characteristics.name: Short-Lived
characteristics.description: Members of this race have shorter lifespans compared to others.

characteristics.name: Light Sensitive
characteristics.description: Bright lights can be harmful or disorienting to this race, especially sunlight.

characteristics.name: Water Allergy
characteristics.description: Water, whether it's rain or a splash, can be harmful or weakening to members of this race.

characteristics.name: Stunted Magic
characteristics.description: While not completely inept, magic is weaker when cast by members of this race.

characteristics.name: Gullible
characteristics.description: Easily deceived, this race tends to believe even the most obvious of lies.

characteristics.name: Fragile
characteristics.description: Lacking physical robustness, this race is easily harmed by physical threats.

characteristics.name: Vulnerable To Magic
characteristics.description: Magic affects this race more profoundly, making them susceptible to spells.

characteristics.name: Territorial
characteristics.description: This race is fiercely protective of their domain, often leading to disputes with neighbors.
